summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K announcing weekly open-market share repurchases under an existing buyback programme instructed to UBS AG on 16 February 2026. Purchases from 24-28 August 2026 totalled approximately 2.68 million ordinary shares at prices ranging from 676.80p to 692.00p per share. All repurchased shares are intended for cancellation. Post-settlement, NatWest holds 178,385,812 shares in treasury, has 7,950,069,185 shares in issue (excluding treasury), and total voting rights of 31,802,209,300. This routine buyback execution is part of ongoing capital returns; watch for programme completion or acceleration.
